A Regular Show-inspired game, reportedly built with Gemini 4 “Argon”.

A park golf cart, escalating enemy waves, and a giant cassette-tape boss. The 160-second clip shows a failed run, a restart, and a win.

What stands out is the complete gameplay loop: movement, combat, health, progression, and clear win/loss states.
